Our Shop

A family shop, in a family neighbourhood

Meyerland is a neighbourhood of families — school runs, Saturday errands, generations on the same street. To2 was set up to match it.

Why "To2"?

Look at our badge and you'll see it: the "o" and the "2" are two overlapping circles — two chairs side by side, two generations in the same shop. That's the whole idea. A grandfather and a grandson can sit down in the same visit. A mum can get her wash & style while her daughter gets her school-term trim in the next chair.

We're a barber and beauty shop together, not one or the other. Haircuts for men, women and kids sit alongside waxing and skin care, because real families don't split their Saturday across three different salons.

You'll find us at 5330 Chimney Rock Rd #2012, in the heart of Meyerland in southwest Houston. And if you didn't book? Walk-ins are welcome — that's not fine print here, it's how half our chairs fill.

Houston has noticed, too: 157 Google reviews, every one of them counted into a perfect 5.0. We work to keep it that way, one chair at a time.

The To2 standard

What a 5.0 has to live up to

A perfect average across 157 reviews only holds if every visit earns it. These are the standards we hold ourselves to — for customers' own words, read the reviews on Google.

Clean, careful cuts

Fades blended properly, necklines tidied, and a final check in the mirror before anyone leaves the chair — that's the finish we aim for, every cut.

Easy walk-ins

No appointment needed — walk-ins are welcome every day we're open, and we'll always tell you honestly how long the wait looks.

Beauty care under one roof
